subject: Fluffy Baby Highland Calf
character_dna: Bobbie Goods aesthetic featuring ultra-thick, clean, monoline line art with bold contours and zero cross-hatching. Chunky, rounded proportions: a round chubby body, stubby short legs with neat split hooves, an oversized fluffy shaggy fringe of hair sweeping over the forehead, tiny soft horn nubs, wide sleepy-happy oval eyes, a broad rounded snout with gentle dimpled nostrils, and wide floppy ears adorned with a simple corduroy collar and round brass bell. High cuteness, easy-to-color broad open shapes.
habitat_rules: Strictly grounded terrestrial setting in the rolling Scottish countryside. Environments include cozy wooden barns with golden hay, soft clover meadows, shallow stone-pebble brooks, and low mossy stone walls. The calf stays firmly on the ground or seated on grass/blankets; never climbing trees, never swimming deep water, and never using human-like elevated furniture.
